title: Spine structural-change prediction beyond baseline morphology
disposition_reason: The existing finite 20-mouse follow-up/baseline ratio endpoint, complete paired delivery, target bridge and 40-context frozen-programme executor are recovered as source. A retained independently accepted receipt establishes exact-source target/input interoperability only. Authentic longitudinal acquisition provenance, matched-method review, native candidate execution and scientific qualification remain separate; this endpoint differs from the paper's pooled stable-spine correlation. Reviewed complete direct numerical presentation and first-supplied response collection are available as source; actual authentic presentation, context/provider custody and scientific qualification remain unestablished. Reviewed direct-provider-v1 adds complete first-answer custody and admission as source under trusted local operation; actual provider/context behavior and scientific qualification remain unestablished.

scientific_target.question: Do pre-followup activity and coactivity measurements reduce held-mouse error in longitudinal spine structural change beyond initial volume and dendritic compartment?
scientific_target.known_answer: Observed follow-up spine volume divided by baseline volume for eligible requested rows, dimensionless, with no change equal to 1. Observed zero is valid; unavailable follow-up is not zero. This is the existing finite prediction protocol's recovered ratio endpoint, not a newly substituted normalized difference or raw next-day size.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Measured longitudinal per-spine morphology in author archive 15047046; the recovered author norm=False transform is follow-up/baseline. Baseline eligibility defines requests; follow-up eligibility separately determines observed labels. The accepted bridge preserved existing float64 ratios rather than recomputing division from raw volumes; elapsed follow-up timing and image-level correspondence remain unqualified.
scientific_target.case_unit: An eligible longitudinal spine pair within mouse/FOV/dendrite; query records are nested within one held-mouse fold.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Mouse; repeated compartments, FOVs, dendrites and spines remain clustered within mouse.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective prediction from published processed measurements. Prediction of morphological change is a measured neural target, but a positive gain does not establish a causal coactivity mechanism.
exclusions: No claim of direct visual identification of plasticity from raw microscopy.
No prospective next-day horizon until actual visit timing is verified.
No independent replication from apical and basal observations of the same mouse.

inputs: Common baseline predictors: baseline volume, basal-compartment indicator, and both local/coincident neural-measurement missingness indicators. The neural view adds local normalized coactivity and normalized dendrite coincidence from the completed Early recording.
The same other nineteen whole mice, ordered training rows and observed ratio labels in both conditions; all transforms, fitting and selection remain training-only under the frozen matched method.
forbidden_inputs: Followup volume, followup activity, neighboring followup outcomes and labels derived from structural change.
Source filenames or IDs encoding held-mouse answer values; other folds whose training outcomes reveal this fold.
observation_contract.case_identity: The fixed support is 27 original members, 20 mice, 1,143 rows, 774 baseline-defined requests and 731 observed ratios; all 774 requests require predictions in each view, including 43 unavailable targets. Exact source identities are pinned by paired-delivery-v1 and target descriptors; biological payloads and private storage locations are not bundled.
observation_contract.split: Complete 40 contexts: each of 20 mice held out in both baseline/neural views with every compartment together and the other nineteen mice as training. Fresh participant realms are required because another fold's training labels reveal this fold's targets. The accepted target/input bridge does not qualify candidate execution or matched-method compliance.
observation_contract.coverage: The 20-mouse, 774-request/731-observed finite task is not all archived spine observations. Executable endpoint, complete paired delivery, private-target conversion and candidate executor source are present; retained accepted interoperability evidence covers all 40 existing contexts without a new participant/model/scientific run.

primary.name: equal_mouse_baseline_minus_neural_mae
primary.aggregation: MAE across eligible spines within each held mouse; average20 mouse differences equally.
primary.rationale: Compare the existing dimensionless follow-up/baseline ratio under matched baseline and neural information; maintain equal-mouse baseline MAE minus neural MAE and complete support. This is not the paper's pooled correlation estimator.

secondary: Report equal_mouse_baseline_mae and equal_mouse_neural_mae separately, plus every mouse and compartment result.
Report original/requested/scored support and every eligibility exclusion; never silently normalize over successful requests.

comparators.name: Initial morphology and compartment
comparators.inputs: Baseline volume, compartment and the two neural-measurement missingness indicators shared with the neural view; no activity values.
comparators.procedure: Freeze the same training-fold-only learner, tuning rule and budget across both original views. Source delivery and same-program checks exist; independent method review and competent candidate/reference execution remain required.

comparators.name: Activity/coactivity added
comparators.inputs: Same baseline information plus pre-followup neural features.
comparators.procedure: Use the identical learner/tuning budget and held-mouse folds; this is an information comparison, not forced imitation of author coefficients.

comparators.name: Measurement-noise and shuffled neural control
comparators.inputs: Baseline features plus mouse/dendrite-block-shuffled neural features.
comparators.procedure: Prospective negative control preserves group dependence and missingness; do not shuffle individual spines across mice.

nuisance_controls: Keep baseline-volume and compartment distribution matched between views.
Freeze volume normalization, spine survival/quality exclusion and followup matching without inspecting candidate outcomes.
Restrict all spatial neighbor features to baseline observations; use mouse clustering for dendrite dependence.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report20 paired mouse differences and a mouse-cluster interval if the recovered roster confirms20 distinct animals. Measurement error and within-mouse dependence prohibit treating731 spines as731 replicates.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require all 40 public contexts and all 774 requested row predictions in each view before private grading; retain failures and reject missing predictions, including predictions for requested rows with unavailable targets. Only the 731 observed ratios enter the original equal-mouse score; missing targets are never zeros or participant-selected exclusions.
